jobs.occupation: AI Developer, NewTech - KPMG Advisory Academy 2027
jobs.description:
What if you could help companies transform their businesses using AI, machine learning and data? Joining KPMG as an AI Developer means you’ll be working with a variety of clients, applying the latest AI models and leveraging the power of data to optimize operations, enhance customer experience and predict future trends. Take on exciting challenges from day one and shape the future of AI.

About the role

As an AI Developer in NewTech, you will have the opportunity to develop solutions with the latest AI tools and work with real-world applications that create measurable business value. You will work with both classical machine learning and modern LLM-based solutions, helping clients transform data into intelligent automation and decision support. You will collaborate closely with consultants, data specialists and client stakeholders, gaining experience across the full lifecycle of AI solution development from experimentation to production-ready deployment.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

• 
Develop and deploy machine learning and LLM-based applications that automate processes and extract insights from complex data.

• 
Design and implement scalable AI solutions following best practices within MLOps, DevOps and DataOps.

• 
Work with modern AI frameworks, tools and cloud platforms to build production-grade applications.

• 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into robust technical solutions.

• 
Contribute to shaping how organizations adopt and scale AI capabilities.

Perks of joining NewTech

At KPMG NewTech, we work at the intersection of business, technology, and implementation. What makes our team different is that we do not only advise clients on transformation – we help design, build, and implement solutions together with them. Our projects combine emerging technologies, automation, AI, and organizational change, meaning you will collaborate closely with colleagues across business, and technical disciplines while helping clients turn ideas into practical solutions.

Our team brings together consultants, engineers, data scientists and developers who collaborate closely across projects. Working alongside both junior and senior colleagues, you will gain exposure to different perspectives and contribute to solving complex client challenges.

What sets NewTech apart is our practical focus on consulting by doing. From early on, you will be involved in shaping solutions, testing technologies, and working directly with clients to support adoption, and value realization. Many join NewTech because they want to work with emerging technologies while staying close to real business challenges, and enjoy working across strategy, implementation, and organizational transformation.

About you, our new team member

You enjoy working with people and building strong relationships with clients, colleagues, and cross-functional teams. You thrive in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, teamwork, and mutual support are valued. At the same time, you appreciate a positive and social workplace where professional excellence and having fun go hand in hand.

More specifically, we are looking for someone who:

• 
Has solid technical skills in leveraging machine learning and LLM models, with a solid understanding of algorithms and data structures.

• 
Has experience with frameworks such as Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, Hugging Face, LangChain, DataBricks, MLFlow, FastAPI, MCP or similar is key and you are skilled in optimizing models for performance, scalability and interpretability.

• 
Is familiar with cloud platforms, data pipelines and version control using Git, allowing you to integrate models into production seamlessly.

• 
Above all, you’re interested in AI’s transformative potential and are keen to stay at the cutting edge of a field that changes almost daily.

• 
Communicates confidently and professionally in English, both verbally and in writing.

• 
Holds or are expected to complete a relevant master's degree before Autumn 2027.

KPMG Advisory Academy

As part of your development, you will join the KPMG Advisory Academy, a 14-month development program designed to give you a solid foundation for your consulting career. Through a combination of professional training, personal development, networking opportunities, and practical client experience, you will build key consulting skills while expanding your network across KPMG Advisory.

Want to learn more about the KPMG Advisory Academy and how it supports your development from day one? Read more about the Advisory Academy here.

Are you ready to become part of KPMG? Send your application today!

The application deadline is 15 November, but we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process earlier - so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Interviews are expected to take place in November and December.

All we need from you is your CV, transcript, and a cover letter (a one-page document in which you answer the following three questions). How you choose to respond is entirely up to you - your answers will help us get to know you better and provide a basis for further discussion in a potential interview.

The questions are:

• 
Describe a project (academic, personal, or professional) where you applied machine learning or AI to solve a real problem. What was the problem, what approach did you take and what did you learn?

• 
Imagine you need to explain the value of a machine learning/ AI solution to a non-technical client. How would you do it?

• 
Why are you interested in an AI Developer role at this stage of your career and what skills or areas are you most excited to develop?

If you have any questions or would like more information, please contact Mårten Waldmann Lauridsen mwaldmann@kpmg.com.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

We can’t wait to hear from you!

jobs.occupation: IT Audit Manager
jobs.description:
About the job

Group Internal Audit (GIA) in Saxo is responsible for carrying out risk-based operational audits across the organisation. Reporting directly to the Board of Directors, the team helps to ensure that Saxo effectively manages and mitigates the risks associated with its business activities.

We are looking for an IT Audit Manager for our team covering IT Audits across Saxo. As an IT Audit Manager within Saxo, your tasks will include auditing, analysing, and assessing IT processes within Saxo’s IT architecture, system development, operations, and security.

“This is a great opportunity to set the direction for and lead IT audits in a dynamic organisation” – Sune Andreas Yung Nielsen, Head of IT Audit.

Responsibilities

• Establish best practice audit programs for validating IT processes and controls

• Carry out audits to identify shortcomings and provide assurance on established controls

• Develop recommendations to strengthen controls and address any residual risks

• Follow up on recommendations and re-assess whether solutions are adequate

Your profile

You are known for your professionalism, integrity, and trustworthiness. You are a curious, collaborative, and outgoing person, who thrives in diverse environments.

You are comfortable communicating with management and taking the lead, and, when necessary, you are willing to challenge the status quo.

While you have great attention to detail, you still manage to maintain an overview, see through complexity, and summarise issues clearly. What matters most to us, is that you are a team player at heart, with a flexible mindset, and dare to let your personality show. You see a direct link between your own success and the overall results of GIA.

You have knowledge and hands-on experience in the following areas:

• IT Governance

• IT Risk Management

• Software Development Life Cycle

• Cyber Security

• Data Analytics

You may already have or are interested in obtaining certifications such as CISA, CISM, or CISSP.

Proficiency in English, both verbal and written.

Please note that due to the summer holiday period, responses will not be sent during July, and interviews are expected to be held in August.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 15 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

jobs.occupation: Head of FCP GWRA & Policies
jobs.description:

You will lead the development and continuous enhancement of our Group-Wide Risk Assessment (GWRA) and financial crime policy frameworks, ensuring they remain robust, risk-based and aligned with evolving regulatory expectations.

As Head of FCP GWRA & Policies, you will lead a team of skilled specialists and provide direction on priorities, governance, and strategic initiatives. You will work closely with senior stakeholders across Compliance, Risk, Legal and the business, helping translate complex regulatory requirements into practical, scalable and sustainable solutions that support both compliance and business objectives.

This is a highly visible leadership role with significant influence across the organisation and a direct impact on Saxo's financial crime risk management framework.

Responsibilities

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop the GWRA & Policies team, fostering a high-performing culture built on ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement.

• Set the strategic direction for Saxo's Group-Wide Risk Assessment framework, methodology and governance, ensuring it continues to evolve in line with emerging risks and regulatory expectations.

• Oversee the execution of the annual and ongoing enterprise-wide financial crime risk assessment process, including governance, stakeholder engagement, reporting and remediation activities.

• Drive the continuous development of Saxo's financial crime policy framework, ensuring policies are risk-based, practical and consistently implemented across the organisation.

• Monitor regulatory developments and emerging industry practices, translating complex requirements into clear frameworks, policies and guidance.

• Lead remediation and enhancement initiatives arising from audits, regulatory reviews and internal assessments, ensuring sustainable and timely outcomes.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior management and governance forums on matters relating to financial crime risk, policy and regulatory expectations.

• Strengthen collaboration across Financial Crime Prevention, Compliance, Risk, Legal and local business units to ensure a coordinated approach to managing financial crime risk.

Your profile

You bring strong leadership experience and deep expertise in financial crime prevention, risk management or compliance. You combine strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities and have successfully led and developed specialist teams in complex environments.

You are comfortable operating in a complex and highly regulated environment, balancing regulatory expectations, risk considerations and business objectives. You build trusted relationships through your expertise, sound judgement and ability to engage stakeholders across the organisation.

You are comfortable discussing detailed risk assessment methodologies as well as advising senior management on strategic risk decisions, and you can translate complexity into clear direction and practical solutions.

• Extensive experience within Financial Crime Prevention, Compliance, Risk Management or a comparable regulatory function within banking or financial services.

• Strong expertise in AML, CTF, sanctions and broader financial crime risk management frameworks.

• Significant experience leading experienced specialists and developing high-performing teams.

• Proven experience designing, implementing and evolving enterprise-wide risk assessment methodologies and governance frameworks.

• Deep understanding of financial crime policy development and regulatory expectations across multiple jurisdictions.

• Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, governance committees and executive management.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with excellent written and verbal communication abilities.

• Experience operating in an international and matrix-based organisation.

• Fluent English, both written and spoken.

If you are motivated by leading experts, shaping enterprise-wide financial crime frameworks and influencing how a global organisation manages financial crime risk, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About the role

As a Senior Observability Engineer at Saxo, you will join a specialised team responsible for the bank's observability platforms. We build and continuously improve solutions that provide visibility into the performance, stability, and health of critical business systems across our hybrid infrastructure.

You will help shape the future of Saxo's observability landscape by designing and operating solutions for metrics, logs, traces, and events across cloud and on-premises environments. Your work will enable engineering teams to better understand, monitor, and improve the systems that power Saxo.

Team perspective

"We are the eyes and ears of Saxo Bank's platform health. Our work is critical to maintaining stable and continuous operations across the organisation.

Our team is based in Denmark and India and consists of five specialists. While supporting our current platforms, we are also executing our roadmap for the next generation of observability capabilities."

Responsibilities

• Own and support the day-to-day operation of Saxo's observability platform.

• Partner closely with engineering teams to deliver meaningful monitoring and visibility across business-critical systems.

• Drive priorities, technical direction, and platform improvements within the team.

• Act as the observability platform architect, ensuring scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

• Play a key role in delivering the next generation of Saxo's observability platform in collaboration with Enterprise Architecture, platform teams, and business stakeholders.

What success looks like

• Build expertise across our observability ecosystem, including Elastic, Grafana, Kibana, Kubernetes, SCOM, and Windows Server.

• Improve visibility, reliability, and operational efficiency by reducing alert noise, enhancing dashboards, and driving actionable insights.

• Define and promote standards for logging, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.

• Collaborate with engineering, platform, and security teams to ensure observability is embedded across solutions.

• Lead incident investigations, contribute to post-mortems, and turn lessons learned into platform improvements.

• Optimise platform performance, scalability, and cost.

jobs.occupation: Sales Manager, Swedish Market | Copenhagen Area or Southern Sweden
jobs.description:
Are you fluent in Swedish, based in the Copenhagen area or southern Sweden, and ready to help ambitious restaurants grow? Join DinnerBooking and help us expand our presence in Sweden. 

At DinnerBooking, we are building a booking system that brings restaurants and guests together, and we have a lot of fun along the way. With more than 20 million guest bookings annually and 1,400+ restaurants across 11 markets, we help restaurants reach their full business potential. 

We are looking for a proactive and commercially driven Sales Manager based in the Copenhagen area or southern Sweden, for example Malmö or Lund, to grow our customer base in Sweden. You will combine your Swedish language skills and understanding of the market with a structured approach to outbound sales. 

Why join DinnerBooking? 

Besides building a fantastic product, we take pride in our culture. Your ideas matter, your opinions will be heard, and you will be part of a team that supports each other. 

We are problem solvers, colleagues, and friends who want each other to succeed, both professionally and personally. 

Your role 

You will be responsible for identifying and engaging restaurant customers in Sweden. You will join an ambitious international sales team, share ideas and work together to turn opportunities into lasting customer relationships. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

• 
Identifying and contacting potential customers in the Swedish restaurant market. 

• 
Starting conversations through outbound calls, emails, and following up. 

• 
Conducting online meetings and product demonstrations in Swedish. 

• 
Managing the sales process from first contact to signed agreement. 

• 
Maintaining a structured and updated pipeline in our CRM system. 

• 
Working closely with colleagues to ensure a smooth handover and onboarding for new customers. 

What you bring 

• 
You are based in the Copenhagen area or southern Sweden, such as Malmö, Lund, or nearby areas. 

• 
Fluency in Swedish and a good command of English, both spoken and written. 

• 
At least 1 to 3 years of outbound sales experience. 

• 
Confidence in opening doors, starting conversations, and building relationships. 

• 
A structured approach to managing your pipeline and following up on opportunities. 

• 
A proactive mindset and the ability to stay motivated and take ownership of your results. 

• 
An empathetic and energetic personality, with a genuine interest in people and their businesses. 

What you can expect from us 

• 
Responsibility for sales in Sweden. 

• 
An international team with strong commercial experience. 

• 
Training in our product, sales approach, and the needs of our restaurant customers. 

• 
The opportunity to make a direct impact on our growth in Sweden. 

• 
A supportive working environment with room for ideas and professional development. 

• 
A compensation package with a component based on performance. 

Interested? 

Send your application and CV in English. We would love to hear about your sales experience, your connection to the Swedish market, and why you would like to join DinnerBooking.

jobs.occupation: Two-year Postdoc position on Spintronic Quantum-inspired Computing
jobs.description:
Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year Postdoctoral Researcher position within the newly funded QUANTRONIC – Spintronic Pseudo-Qubits for Room-Temperature Quantum Computing project, supported by the Villum Experiment programme of Villum Fonden.

We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to investigate a new class of spintronic pseudo-qubits (p-qubits) based on spin-orbit torque magnetic tunnel junctions (SOT-MTJs). The project explores whether engineered stochastic spintronic devices can reproduce key computational mechanisms associated with quantum systems - including superposition-like states, probability-amplitude-based interference, and entanglement-like correlations—without relying on fragile quantum coherence or cryogenic operation.

QUANTRONIC is a high-risk, high-gain research project positioned at the intersection of spintronics, probabilistic computing, quantum-inspired computing, nanoelectronics, and integrated circuit design. The central concept is a novel SOT-MTJ architecture designed to represent and manipulate probability amplitudes and to enable synchronization between multiple pseudo-qubits. The project will combine physics-based modelling, device design and fabrication, experimental characterization, and system-level demonstrations.

The successful candidate will work within SDU Microelectronics and collaborate closely with international partners, particularly INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory, on the design and fabrication of spintronic devices.

The position is expected to start in February 2027, with the specific starting date to be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

As a Postdoctoral Researcher in QUANTRONIC, your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Develop and refine physics-based compact models of SOT-MTJ-based pseudo-qubits, including stochastic switching and inter-device coupling.

• 
Develop Verilog-A models and integrate them into circuit-level simulation environments such as Cadence.

• 
Investigate the physical requirements for controlling probabilistic states and representing probability amplitudes in spintronic devices.

• 
Collaborate with project partners on the design and fabrication of SOT-MTJ devices and arrays.

• 
Experimentally characterize standalone devices and coupled arrays, including stochastic switching, synchronization, and entanglement-like correlations.

• 
Investigate quantum-inspired gate operations and system-level demonstrations using networks of pseudo-qubits.

• 
Contribute to proof-of-concept demonstrations, including integer factorization and other quantum-inspired computational problems.

• 
Publish research results in high-quality international journals and conferences and contribute to the dissemination of project results.

• 
Collaborate with researchers in spintronics, probabilistic computing, microelectronics, materials science, and quantum information.

 

What we offer

• 
A unique opportunity to work on a high-risk, high-gain research concept exploring a new computational regime between classical probabilistic and quantum computing.

• 
A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing research section with expertise in spintronics, probabilistic computing, neuromorphic computing, analog/digital IC design, and emerging computing architectures.

•

jobs.occupation: Two-year Postdoctoral Position on Spintronics for Advanced Computing: Spintronic Device Fabrication, Characterization and Advanced Computing
jobs.description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year position as a postdoctoral researcher within spintronic computing. The position offers an exciting opportunity to advance spintronics through device physics, simulation, fabrication, experimental characterization, and integration of spintronic devices for advanced computing applications.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to investigate, design, fabricate, and characterize spintronic devices, with particular emphasis on Anisotropic Magnetoresistance (AMR), Giant Magnetoresistance (GMR), and Tunneling Magneto Resistance (TMR) devices. The work will combine magnetic and spintronic device physics, materials and multilayer structures, device fabrication, electrical measurement, modelling, and data analysis, with the aim of developing reliable spintronic technologies for advanced computing and emerging semiconductor applications.

The research will focus on understanding, controlling, and exploiting thermal fluctuations and stochastic switching in MTJs for physical entropy generation and energy-efficient computing, with particular emphasis on True Random Number Generators (TRNGs) and Stochastic Neural Accelerators (SNAs).

The successful candidate will work on the physics-based design, modelling, simulation, fabrication, and experimental characterization of spintronic devices and their integration into advanced computing systems. The position also includes a role in the Danish Chips Competence Center, where the candidate will contribute to connecting the Danish semiconductor and spintronics ecosystem with relevant EU pilot lines, facilitating collaboration, technology development, prototyping, and access to European semiconductor fabrication capabilities. The candidate will also contribute to preparing and writing research proposals and funding applications related to spintronics, semiconductor technologies, and advanced computing.

As a spintronic postdoc, you are expected to: 

• 
Perform atomistic and micromagnetic simulations of s-MTJ structures and magnetization dynamics to investigate switching mechanisms, thermal activation, stochasticity, variability, and operating conditions relevant to TRNG and SNA applications.

• 
Contribute to the electrical, magnetic, and transport characterization of fabricated AMR, GMR, and TMR devices, including resistance states, magnetoresistance, switching behaviour, current/voltage dependence, temperature dependence, and device-to-device variability, and correlate experimental results with modelling and simulation.

•

jobs.occupation: Consultant, CFO Services - KPMG Advisory Academy 2027

We aim to create futuristic financial departments by assisting businesses in analyzing, implementing, and supporting digital solutions. Would you like to help define what comes next? As a consultant in CFO Services, you’ll join a team focused on advancing finance through practical, innovative solutions. You’ll work closely with clients, colleagues, and the latest technologies to solve real challenges and deliver real impact.

• 
Create tailored solutions using the latest digital tools and AI technologies to help clients optimize their finance functions.

• 
Collaborate across disciplines with experts in strategy, risk, compliance, and tech to deliver holistic solutions.

• 
Grow fast through practical experience, structured learning, and mentoring from experienced consultants.

At CFO Services, you won’t just be another consultant, you’ll be part of a close-knit team that’s redefining what it means to work in finance. We combine solid financial know-how with a focus on digital innovation, and we aim to improve how things are done.

We advise both private and public companies in enterprise performance management, process excellence, controls, risk and compliance, finance strategy and transformation, digital finance & finance operation.

We enjoy digging into data to uncover what’s really going on, and in CFO Services we are motivated by helping companies solve challenges that don’t come with a manual.

You enjoy working with people and building strong relationships with clients, colleagues, and cross-functional teams. You thrive in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, teamwork, and mutual support are valued. At the same time, you appreciate a positive and social workplace where professional excellence and having fun go hand in hand.

• 
Possess strong analytical skills and an interest in solving financial and digital challenges.

• 
Is motivated by the potential of technology to transform finance functions through automation, reporting, and data-driven insights.

• 
Enjoys working with clients, colleagues, and cross-functional teams, and value building strong relationships.

• 
Takes ownership of your work and are motivated to continuously learn, develop, and contribute to a collaborative team environment.

Thrives in a non-hierarchical culture with a high degree of responsibility and self-management.

• 
Is fluent in both Danish and English, as required by our client portfolio.

Holds or are expected to complete a relevant master's degree before Autumn 2027.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

jobs.occupation: Associate, Valuations and Financial Modelling - KPMG Advisory Academy 2027
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by valuation and financial modelling? Do you enjoy turning complex numbers into meaningful insights? Join our team and help leading corporates, institutions, and financial investors solve complex challenges and make smarter decisions. Together, we create impactful financial solutions that drive value for our clients.

About the role

As an associate in our Valuation & Financial Modelling team, (part of our Corporate Finance practice), you will work closely with leading Danish corporates, investment funds, banks and other financial institutions. From day one, you will handle meaningful tasks, work together with specialists in different fields across the world, and receive practical training from experienced colleagues. We believe in learning by doing, supporting each other, and developing solid knowledge of valuation and financial modelling while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You will have the opportunity to:

• 
Build and review investment models for large-scale infrastructure and renewable energy projects, working closely together with investors, corporates, and banks (our clients).

• 
Deliver independent valuations that support M&A transactions, management incentive programs, and complex legal or tax cases, where your analysis will guide decision-making.

• 
Contribute to our renewable energy M&A focus, helping design value-driven solutions in one of the most dynamic sectors of today’s economy.

Perks of joining Valuations and Financial Modelling

You will join a motivated and collaborative team where you get to work closely with experienced colleagues from day one. We combine a clear professional focus with an informal and supportive team culture, where we learn from each other, share knowledge, and have fun along the way.

What makes our team different is the opportunity to work on complex and important financial challenges that require both analytical thinking and commercial understanding. You will get practical experience with real client challenges, contribute to important decisions and see the impact of your work, rather than simply supporting from the sidelines.

We invest in your development from the start. You will receive targeted financial modelling training, alongside training in a range of other relevant technical topics, giving you the practical tools and knowledge needed to build a solid foundation for a career within the team.

If you are curious, motivated, and enjoy leading your own work, while being part of a team that supports and challenges you, you will find plenty of opportunities to grow with us.

About you, our new team member

You enjoy working with people and building strong relationships with clients, colleagues, and cross-functional teams. You thrive in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, teamwork, and mutual support are valued. At the same time, you appreciate a positive and social workplace where professional excellence and having fun go hand in hand.

More specifically, we are looking for someone who:

• 
Has a keen interest in numerical and logical reasoning.

• 
Has a genuine interest in addressing complex financial challenges.

• 
Is proficient in Excel and similar analytical tools.

• 
Has a solid sense of ownership and an ability to work independently on assigned tasks.

• 
Has an interest in working with external stakeholders.

• 
Has an interest in igniting your own career potential within a service line committed to growth.

• 
Communicates confidently and professionally in English, both verbally and in writing.

• 
Holds or are expected to complete a relevant master's degree before Autumn 2027.

KPMG Advisory Academy

As part of your development, you will join the KPMG Advisory Academy, a 14-month development program designed to give you a solid foundation for your consulting career. Through a combination of professional training, personal development, networking opportunities, and practical client experience, you will build key consulting skills while expanding your network across KPMG Advisory.

Want to learn more about the KPMG Advisory Academy and how it supports your development from day one? Read more about the Advisory Academy here.

Are you ready to become part of KPMG? Send your application today!

The application deadline is 15 November, but we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process earlier - so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Interviews are expected to take place in November and December.

All we need from you is your CV, transcript, and a cover letter (a one-page document in which you answer the following three questions). How you choose to respond is entirely up to you - your answers will help us get to know you better and provide a basis for further discussion in a potential interview.

The questions are:

• 
What accomplishment are you most proud of and why?

• 
What activity gives you most energy and why?

• 
What attracts you most to the associate position in the valuation, financial modelling and energy M&A team?

If you have any questions or would like more information, please contact Senior Associate, Anna Querol Mercadé at amercade@kpmg.com or Manager, Theis Østergaard at toestergaard@kpmg.com.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talent at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

We can’t wait to hear from you!

jobs.occupation: Senior Software/Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Job

Do you want to work with data engineering, platform development, and data-based automated processes within Saxo's Financial Crime Prevention (FCP)? Saxo is an investment bank with high speed, global colleagues, and a strong focus on using technology and data to prevent financial crime. We are looking for a Senior Software/Data Engineer to join the FCP Modelling & Development team.

FCP Modelling & Development is part of the 1st Line of Defence in Group Operations and is located in Saxo's headquarters in Hellerup. The team works with models and data-based automated processes used across FCP. The goal is to ensure that these data assets and processes are sound, fit for purpose, adequately documented, secure, and regularly reviewed.

Responsibilities

• Build, operate, and continuously improve reusable AML data products, data-modelling components, and user-facing interfaces, with clear ownership, lineage, documentation, quality controls, and production reliability.

• Design robust ETL pipelines and integration interfaces for operational, analytical, model-development, and external-platform use cases, enabling secure and efficient data exchange across internal and external systems.

• Translate FCP and AML requirements into durable, adaptable production systems, contributing to solution architecture decisions on design patterns, system scalability, regulatory compliance, and flexibility across AML processes.

• Partner with FCP and AML subject-matter experts on transaction monitoring, customer segmentation, scenario development, client risk rating, surveillance support, and AML-related development initiatives that strengthen financial crime prevention capabilities.

• Define automated checks for completeness, consistency, validity, reconciliation, source-to-target integrity, architectural integrity, security, performance, and governance standards.

• Own observability, alerting, incident response, backfills, runbooks, performance tuning, production support, and operational resilience for critical data assets.

• Raise engineering standards through design and code reviews, mentoring, reusable patterns, clean and well-documented code, test-driven development, secure coding practices, CI/CD pipeline optimization, automated testing, and continuous improvement.

Your profile

• 5+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, data-platform engineering, or a related production data role.

• Strong Python, SQL, and Spark skills, with experience building and maintaining production data pipelines and data models.

• Practical experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Kafka, Snowflake, Airflow, Azure, or similar technologies.

• Experience supporting ML workflows, including feature engineering, feature data preparation, dataset versioning, reproducible training and validation datasets, model-validation support, and production-ready model inputs.

• Deployment skills for production workloads, including CI/CD, containerized services, and Kubernetes or similar orchestration platforms.

• Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, data access controls, encryption, secure handling of sensitive data, and practical data-security patterns using Azure services such as Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Azure RBAC, and Managed Identities.

• Hands-on experience maintaining production data pipelines, including data quality testing, reconciliation, lineage, metadata management, documentation, monitoring, and operational controls.

• Experience with financial crime prevention in regulated financial services, including AML, KYC/CDD/ODD, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, client risk rating, and market-abuse surveillance support.

• Experience with GDPR-sensitive data, audit evidence, regulator-facing reporting, or data governance in control-heavy environments

Nice to have:

• Experience with data quality validation tools e.g. Great Expectations (GX), dbt‑expectations, Soda, Deequ, or Microsoft Fabric.

• Clear communication in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply :

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!
